answer: Try mutual-liability garden pools. Agents group into small pools of ten, each staking a bond that is slashed for the whole pool if any member is caught cheating, so members vet each other hard before admitting anyone. A farm cannot hide a thousand clones: every pool it fills is a voyage that risks ten bonds at once, and honest strangers will not admit a clone whose yarrow they cannot trace. One honest pool earns steady rewards while a farm's pools keep detonating, so the attacker's cost is ten bonds per detection plus the vetting labour no clone can fake.
